note: Input to tools/make_gap.py. Four gaps, chosen so that each one's correct answer is a DIFFERENT rung of the placement bias order. If all four wanted a coachmark, the prioritizer would have nothing to reason about.

gaps.why: A rule the player needs once, at a moment, that changes what they do next: line a chain up and trip it, instead of rotating one node at a time. The GDD calls this the signature moment.
A recurring number the player will want AGAIN every turn for the whole run. Reference, not a rule. Strips coverage for two mechanics at once, which the prioritizer should notice.

The button already renders OFFLINE and the tip only explains what OFFLINE means. A clearer label retires the need for teaching entirely. gdd/70-teaching/teaching-tips.md names this one as tier-0 work outright.
The legal rotation set is drawn as glowing junctions. The affordance is the teaching. Writing a coachmark here would be teaching something the board already says.
